notes.title: Updated Demo is Live!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]I’ve just uploaded a new version of the [b]Papercraft Tactics[/b] demo, and it comes with a lot of updates based on feedback and testing. Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]🎨 [b]Complete character visual overhaul[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🗡️ [b]New items[/b] to experiment with[/p][/*][*][p]👤 [b]3 starting characters[/b]: Warrior, Druid, and Pirate[/p][/*][*][p]🃏 [b]Card system rework[/b] – now with a deck editor[/p][/*][*][p]⚖️ [b]General rebalancing[/b] across the game[/p][/*][*][p]⚙️ [b]Quality of life improvements[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Battle pause[/p][/*][*][p]Inspect inventory during battle[/p][/*][*][p]Inspect enemy abilities during battle[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]❓ [b]Simple tutorial[/b] via the \[?] button[/p][/*][*][p]📖 [b]Descriptions added[/b] for stats, buttons, and items to make mechanics clearer[/p][/*][*][p]🐞 And of course, [b]bug fixes[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]👉 You can grab the updated demo here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3380700/Papercraft_Tactics/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]I’d love to hear your impressions of the new version — whether you tried the old demo before or are jumping in for the first time. Feedback is super valuable at this stage, and if you like where the game is going, please consider adding it to your wishlist![/p][p]Thanks for playing and supporting the project 🙏[/p]
